messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "ask doctor or pharmacist if unsure how to use injection"
set: ["ask doctor or pharmacist if unsure how to use injection", "ask doctor or pharmacist for list of medicines if unsure", "consult doctor or pharmacist if unsure whether medication is an MAOI", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you need help", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions", "ask your doctor how to stop using safely", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have liver disease", "ask pharmacist or doctor to explain any part not understood", "ask your doctor or pharmacist for more information", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have unexplained weight loss", "ask your doctor or pharmacist first if you need a painkiller", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have trouble or pain with swallowing", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have nausea or vomiting, stomach pain", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you do not understand these instructions", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have frequent chest pain, heartburn with wheezing", "ask pharmacist for dose-measuring device if not available"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
